description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 17.04.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, which is a regulatory function. The content involves setting and modifying legal financial parameters for trade and customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
